Messages.Author: cordovader
Messages.Body:
Both French National- and European Qualifier Tournament
Paris, France
23rd June 2012
3R + F
Jorge Delgado
www.vekn.net/index.php/event-calendar/event/6779

Sorry for not using ARDB, but I don't have it on my current laptop. I'm recovering the deck from a written list.

Deck Name: The Spanish Tornado
Author: Soufiane Bouzouf, modifications by Jorge Delgado

Qualified last for the final (with only 2 VPs and no GWs). I think I had very bad luck with table positions in the whole tournament in general, where I tried desperately to maximize my VPs, but was victim of multiple rushes in 2/3 tables. In the final I think I had really good luck with the positions (since I entered last). That, plus my patience, plus Guilhem's kamikaze gameplay gave me the GW.

Didn't have any Jackie, so in fact it should be -1 Eddie Gaines and +1 Jackie. I'm actually thinking of taking out 1 Misdirection and 1 Tribute to the Master to include 1 Sudden Reversal. The deck works quite ok in General.
